sections.label: Book 21
sections.name: The Sautramani concluded: prayers to Varuna and Indra

verses.sa: इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृडय। त्वामस्वस्युरा चके॥
verses.tr: imaṃ me varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḍaya tvāmasvasyurā cake
verses.en: Varuna, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this$ day. Longing for help I yearn for thee.

verses.sa: तत्त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस्तदा शास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः। अहेडमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशंस मा न आयुः प्र मोषीः॥
verses.tr: tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ aheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ
verses.en: I ask this of thee with my prayer, etc., as in XVIII..

verses.sa: त्वं नो अग्ने वरुणस्य विद्वान् देवस्य हेडो व यासिसीष्ठाः। यजिष्ठो वह्नितमः शोशुचानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya heḍo va yāsisīṣṭhāḥ yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi pra mumugdhyasmat
verses.en: Do thou who knowest Varuna, O Agni, put far away from us the God's displeasure. Best Sacrificer, brightest One, refulgent, remove thou' far from us all those who hate us.

verses.sa: स त्वं नो अग्नेऽवमो भवोती नेदिष्ठो अस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ। अव यक्ष्व नो वरुणं रराणो वीहि मृडीक सुहवो न एधि॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ no agne'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau ava yakṣva no varuṇaṃ rarāṇo vīhi mṛḍīka suhavo na edhi
verses.en: Be thou the nearest unto us, O Agni, our closest Friend while now this Morn is breaking. Reconcile Varuna to us, be bounteous: show thy compassion and be swift to hear us.

verses.sa: महीमू षु मातरं सुव्रतानामृतस्य पत्नीमवसे हुवेम। तुविक्षत्रामजरन्तीमुरूचीं सुशर्माणमदितिं सुप्रणीतिम्॥
verses.tr: mahīmū ṣu mātaraṃ suvratānāmṛtasya patnīmavase huvema tuvikṣatrāmajarantīmurūcīṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim
verses.en: We call to succour us the mighty Mother of those whose sway is just, the Queen of Order, Strong-ruler, far-expanding, ne'er decaying, Aditi gracious guide and good protectress.

verses.sa: सुत्रामाणं पृथिवीं द्यामनेहसं सुशर्माणमदिति सुप्रणीतिम्। दैवीं नावं स्वरित्रामनागसमस्रवन्तीमा रुहेमा स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyāmanehasaṃ suśarmāṇamaditi supraṇītim daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrāmanāgasamasravantīmā ruhemā svastaye
verses.en: Sinless may we ascend, for weal, this vessel rowed with good oars, divine, that never leaketh, Earth our strong guard, incomparable Heaven. Aditi gracious guide and good protectress.

verses.sa: सुनावमा रुहेयमस्रवन्तीमनागसम्। शतारित्रां स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: sunāvamā ruheyamasravantīmanāgasam śatāritrāṃ svastaye
verses.en: May I ascend the goodly ship, free from defect, that leaketh not, Moved by a hundred oars, for weal.

verses.sa: आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम्। मध्वा रजांसि सुक्रतू॥
verses.tr: ā no mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatam madhvā rajāṃsi sukratū
verses.en: O- Varuna, gracious Pair, with fatness dew our pasturage. With mead the regions of the air.

verses.sa: प्र बाहवा सिसृतं जीवसे न आ नो गव्यूतिमुक्षतं घृतेन। आ मा जने श्रवयतं युवाना श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमा॥
verses.tr: pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase na ā no gavyūtimukṣataṃ ghṛtena ā mā jane śravayataṃ yuvānā śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemā
verses.en: Stretch forth your arms and let our lives be he lengthened: with fatness? dew the pastures of our cattle. Ye Youthful, make us famed among the people: hear, Mitca-Varuna, these mine invocations.

verses.sa: शं नो भवन्तु वाजिनो हवेषु देवताता मितद्रवः स्वर्काः। जम्भयन्तोऽहिं वृकं रक्षांसि सनेम्यस्मद्युयवन्नमीवाः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ no bhavantu vājino haveṣu devatātā mitadravaḥ svarkāḥ jambhayanto'hiṃ vṛkaṃ rakṣāṃsi sanemyasmadyuyavannamīvāḥ
verses.en: Bless us the Coursers when we call, etc, as in IX.

verses.sa: वाजे-वाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो धनेषु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः। अस्य मध्वः पिबत मादयध्वं तृप्ता यात पथिभिर्देवयानैः॥
verses.tr: vāje-vāje'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ
verses.en: Deep-skilled in Law, etc., as in IX.

verses.sa: समिद्धो अग्निः समिधा सुसमिद्धो वरेण्यः। गायत्री छन्द इन्द्रियं त्र्यविर्गौर्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: samiddho agniḥ samidhā susamiddho vareṇyaḥ gāyatrī chanda indriyaṃ tryavirgaurvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: Kindled is Agni with the brand, yea, kindled well, the excellent. The metre Gayatri, the steer of eighteen months, give |}power and life!

verses.sa: तनूनपाच्छुचिव्रतस्तनूपाश्च सरस्वती। उष्णिहा छन्द इन्द्रियं दित्यवाड्गौर्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: tanūnapācchucivratastanūpāśca sarasvatī uṣṇihā chanda indriyaṃ dityavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: Tanunapat whose acts are pure, our bodies' guard Sarasvati, Dshnihil metre and the steer of two years' age give power and life!

verses.sa: इडाभिरग्निरीड्यः सोमो देवो अमर्त्यः। अनुष्टुप्छन्द इन्द्रियं पञ्चाविर्गौर्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: iḍābhiragnirīḍyaḥ somo devo amartyaḥ anuṣṭupchanda indriyaṃ pañcāvirgaurvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: Agni with offerings, meet for praise, and Soma the immortal God, Anushtup metre and the steer of thirty months give power and life!

verses.sa: सुबर्हिरग्निः पूषण्वान्त्स्तीर्णबर्हिरमर्त्यः। बृहती छन्द इन्द्रियं त्रिवत्सो गौर्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: subarhiragniḥ pūṣaṇvāntstīrṇabarhiramartyaḥ bṛhatī chanda indriyaṃ trivatso gaurvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: Agni with (goodly grass spread out, deathless with Pdshan at his side, Brihati metre and a steer of three years' age give power and life!

verses.sa: दुरो देवीर्दिशो महीर्ब्रह्मा देवो बृहस्पतिः। पङ्क्तिश्छन्द इहेन्द्रियं तुर्यवाड्गौर्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: duro devīrdiśo mahīrbrahmā devo bṛhaspatiḥ paṅktiśchanda ihendriyaṃ turyavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: The Doors divine, the mighty Regions, Brahmi, God Brihaspati. The metre Pankti, here a bull in his. fourth year, give power and life!

verses.sa: उषे यह्वी सुपेशसा विश्वे देवा अमर्त्याः। त्रिष्टुप्छन्द इहेन्द्रियं पष्ठवाड्गौर्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: uṣe yahvī supeśasā viśve devā amartyāḥ triṣṭupchanda ihendriyaṃ paṣṭhavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: The two young Dawns of lovely form, the deathless Universal Gods, The Trishtup metre, here, a bull in his sixth year, give power and life! I

verses.sa: दैव्या होतारा भिषजेन्द्रेण सयुजा युजा। जगती छन्द इन्द्रियमनड्वान्गौर्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā bhiṣajendreṇa sayujā yujā jagatī chanda indriyamanaḍvāngaurvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: The two celestial Hotars, both Physicians, Indra's close-knit friends, The metre Jagati, an ox who draws the wain, give power and life! I

verses.sa: तिस्र इडा सरस्वती भारती मरुतो विशः। विराट् छन्द इहेन्द्रियं धेनुर्गौर्न वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: tisra iḍā sarasvatī bhāratī maruto viśaḥ virāṭ chanda ihendriyaṃ dhenurgaurna vayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: The Three, Ida, Sarasvati, and Bharati, the Marut folk, Viraj the metre, here, a cow in milk, a bull, give power and life!

verses.sa: त्वष्टा तुरीपो अद्भुत इन्द्राग्नी पुष्टिवर्धना। द्विपदा छन्द इन्द्रियमुक्षा गौर्न वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā turīpo adbhuta indrāgnī puṣṭivardhanā dvipadā chanda indriyamukṣā gaurna vayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: Tvashtar the wondrous, full of seed, Indragnt furtherers of weal, Dvipada metre, and a cow and vigorous bull give power "and life!

verses.sa: शमिता नो वनस्पतिः सविता प्रसुवन् भगम्। ककुप्छन्द इहेन्द्रियं वशा वेहद्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: śamitā no vanaspatiḥ savitā prasuvan bhagam kakupchanda ihendriyaṃ vaśā vehadvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: Our slaughterer Vanaspati?, Savitar who proraoteth wealth, The metre Kakup, here, a cow who casts her calf, give power and life!

verses.sa: स्वाहा यज्ञं वरुणः सुक्षत्रो भेषजं करत्। अतिच्छन्दा इन्द्रियं बृहदृषभो गौर्वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: svāhā yajñaṃ varuṇaḥ sukṣatro bheṣajaṃ karat aticchandā indriyaṃ bṛhadṛṣabho gaurvayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: With SvAha mighty "Varuna give healing power to Sacrifice! I The Atichhandas, Brihat, and a steer and bull give power and life!

verses.sa: वसन्तेन ऋतुना देवा वसववस्त्रिवृता स्तुताः। रथन्तरेण तेजसा हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: vasantena ṛtunā devā vasavavastrivṛtā stutāḥ rathantareṇa tejasā havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: With the Spring Season may the Gods the Vasus praised with triple hymn And with Rathantara, give life to Indra, splendour, sacrifice,

verses.sa: ग्रीष्मेण ऋतुना देवा रुद्राः पञ्चदशे स्तुताः। बृहता यशसा बलं हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: grīṣmeṇa ṛtunā devā rudrāḥ pañcadaśe stutāḥ bṛhatā yaśasā balaṃ havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: With Summer may the Rudras, Gods, praised in the Pafiichadasa hymn With Brihat, give to Indra strength; with fame, and sacrifice and life.

verses.sa: वर्षाभिरृतुनाऽऽदित्या स्तोमे सप्तदशे स्तुताः। वैरूपेण विशौजसा हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: varṣābhirṛtunā''dityā stome saptadaśe stutāḥ vairūpeṇa viśaujasā havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: May the Adityas with the Rains, lauded in Saptadasa hymn And with V Vairupa, with folk, strength, give Indra sacrifice and life.

verses.sa: शारदेन ऋतुना देवा एकविंश ऋभव स्तुताः। वैराजेन श्रिया श्रियं हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: śāradena ṛtunā devā ekaviṃśa ṛbhava stutāḥ vairājena śriyā śriyaṃ havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: With Autumn may the Ribhus, Gods, praised in the Ekavimsa hymn And with Viraja, give with grace to Indra grace, life, sacrifice.

verses.sa: हेमन्तेन ऋतुना देवास्त्रिणवे मरुत स्तुताः। बलेन शक्वरीः सहो हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: hemantena ṛtunā devāstriṇave maruta stutāḥ balena śakvarīḥ saho havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: With Winter may the Maruts, Gods, praised in the laud of thrice nine parts, The Sakvaris, with strength give might to Indra, sacrifice and life.

verses.sa: शैशिरेण ऋतुना देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशेऽमृता स्तुताः। सत्येन रेवतीः क्षत्रं हविरिन्द्रे वयो दधुः॥
verses.tr: śaiśireṇa ṛtunā devāstrayastriṃśe'mṛtā stutāḥ satyena revatīḥ kṣatraṃ havirindre vayo dadhuḥ
verses.en: With Dew-time may the deathless Gods praised in the Thirty-three-part laud, The Revatis, with truth give sway to Indra, sacrifice and life.

verses.sa: होता यक्षत्समिधाऽग्निमिडस्पदेऽश्विनेन्द्रं सरस्वतीमजो धूम्रो न गोधूमैः कुवलैर्भेषजं मधु शष्पैर्न तेज इन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣatsamidhā'gnimiḍaspade'śvinendraṃ sarasvatīmajo dhūmro na godhūmaiḥ kuvalairbheṣajaṃ madhu śaṣpairna teja indriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar sacrifice with fuel to Agni in the place of libation, to the Asvins, Indra, Sarasvatt. A grey-coloured he-goat with wheat, jujube-fruit and sprouts of rice becomes a sweet salutary remedy, splendour, might, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy sweet butter with foaming liquor. Hotar, present offerings of butter.

verses.sa: होता यक्षत्तनूनपात्सरस्वतीमविर्मेषो न भेषजं पथा मधुमता भरन्नश्विनेन्द्राय वीर्यं बदरैरुपवाकाभिर्भेषजं तोक्मभिः पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣattanūnapātsarasvatīmavirmeṣo na bheṣajaṃ pathā madhumatā bharannaśvinendrāya vīryaṃ badarairupavākābhirbheṣajaṃ tokmabhiḥ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar, Taniinapit, worship Sarasvati. A sheep, a ram, a salutary remedy on the honey-sweet path, bearing to the Asvins and Indra heroic strength, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, sprouts of rice, becomes a salutary remedy, milk. Soma. Let them enjoy, etc., as in verse

verses.sa: होता यक्षन्नराशंसं न नग्नहुं पतिं सुरया भेषजं मेषः सरस्वती भिषग्रथो न चन्द्रयश्विनोर्वपा इन्द्रस्य वीर्यं बदरैरुपवाकाभिर्भेषजं तोक्मभिः पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣannarāśaṃsaṃ na nagnahuṃ patiṃ surayā bheṣajaṃ meṣaḥ sarasvatī bhiṣagratho na candrayaśvinorvapā indrasya vīryaṃ badarairupavākābhirbheṣajaṃ tokmabhiḥ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship Naras and the Lord Nagnahu. A ram with Sur& a salutary remedy, Sarasvati the Physician, the golden car of the Asvins, the victim's omentum, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, and rice-sprouts, become a salutary remedy, the manly strength of Indra, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षदिडेडित आजुह्वानः सरस्वतीमिन्द्रं बलेन वर्धयन्नृषभेण गवेन्द्रियमश्विनेन्द्राय भेषजं यवै र्कर्कन्धुभिर्मधु लाजैर्न मासरं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadiḍeḍita ājuhvānaḥ sarasvatīmindraṃ balena vardhayannṛṣabheṇa gavendriyamaśvinendrāya bheṣajaṃ yavai rkarkandhubhirmadhu lājairna māsaraṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar, magnified with oblations, offering sacrifice, worship Sarasvati and Indra, increasing them with strength, with a bull and a cow. Strength and medicine to the Asvins and Indra are meath with jujube-fruit, Masara with parched grain, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षद्बर्हिरूर्णम्म्रदा भिषङ्नासत्या भिषजाऽश्विनाऽश्वा शिशुमती भिषग्धेनुः सरस्वती भिषग्दुह इन्द्राय भेषजं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadbarhirūrṇammradā bhiṣaṅnāsatyā bhiṣajā'śvinā'śvā śiśumatī bhiṣagdhenuḥ sarasvatī bhiṣagduha indrāya bheṣajaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship the wool-soft Altar-grass, the Physicians Nasatyas, the Physicians Asvins. A mare with a foal, a milch-cow is a physician. Sarasvati the Physician yields medicine to Indra, milk. Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षद्दुरो दिशः कवष्यो न व्यचस्वतीरश्विभ्यां न दुरो दिश इन्द्रो न रोदसी दुघे दुहे धेनुः सरस्वत्यश्विनेन्द्राय भेषजं शुक्रं न ज्योतिरिन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadduro diśaḥ kavaṣyo na vyacasvatīraśvibhyāṃ na duro diśa indro na rodasī dughe duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatyaśvinendrāya bheṣajaṃ śukraṃ na jyotirindriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship the Doors, the Regions, the resounding- \n^f expansive Doors, the Regions, with the Asvins. Indra milks the two milky worlds. The Milch-cow Sarasvati yields medicine for the Asvins and Indra, pure light and strength. Milk, Soma. Let them, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षत्सुपेशसोषे नक्तं दिवाऽश्विना समञ्जाते सरस्वत्या त्विषिमिन्द्रे न भेषजं श्येनो न रजसा हृदा श्रिया न मासरं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣatsupeśasoṣe naktaṃ divā'śvinā samañjāte sarasvatyā tviṣimindre na bheṣajaṃ śyeno na rajasā hṛdā śriyā na māsaraṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hota worship the two fair-formed Dawns. At night and by day the Asvins with Sarasvati compose impetuous power, like healing balm, in Indra, like a falcon, MAsara with light, thought, and grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षद्दैव्या होतारा भिषजाऽश्विनेन्द्रं न जागृवि दिवा नक्तं न भेषजैः शूषं सरस्वती भिषक् सीसेन दुह इन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣaddaivyā hotārā bhiṣajā'śvinendraṃ na jāgṛvi divā naktaṃ na bheṣajaiḥ śūṣaṃ sarasvatī bhiṣak sīsena duha indriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship the two divine Hotars, the Physician A$Vins, and Indra. Watchfully by day and night Sarasvati as Physician, with balms, with lead, yields strength and power. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षत्तिस्रो देवीर्न भेषजं त्रयस्त्रिधातवोऽपसो रूपमिन्द्रे हिरण्ययमश्विनेडा न भारती वाचा सरस्वती मह इन्द्राय दुह इन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣattisro devīrna bheṣajaṃ trayastridhātavo'paso rūpamindre hiraṇyayamaśvineḍā na bhāratī vācā sarasvatī maha indrāya duha indriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship the three Goddesses. The three active ones, with three sacrificial elements, lay balm and golden hue on Indra. The Asvins, Bharati—Sarasvatt with Speech yields might and power to Indra. }Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षत् सुरेरसमृषभं नर्यापसं त्वष्टारमिन्द्रमश्विना भिषजं न सरस्वतीमोजो न जूतिरिन्द्रियं वृको न रभसो भिषग् यशः सुरया भेषजं श्रिया न मासरं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣat surerasamṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasaṃ tvaṣṭāramindramaśvinā bhiṣajaṃ na sarasvatīmojo na jūtirindriyaṃ vṛko na rabhaso bhiṣag yaśaḥ surayā bheṣajaṃ śriyā na māsaraṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship Tvasbtar full of good seed, the Bull active for men, Indra, the Asvins, Sarasvati the Phy^cian. Vigour, speed, power, a fierce wolf as physician, fame with Sur is a medicine, Masara with grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षद्वनस्पतिं शमितारं शतक्रतुं भीमं न मन्युं राजानं व्याघ्रं नमसाऽश्विना भामं सरस्वती भिषगिन्द्राय दुह इन्द्रियं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadvanaspatiṃ śamitāraṃ śatakratuṃ bhīmaṃ na manyuṃ rājānaṃ vyāghraṃ namasā'śvinā bhāmaṃ sarasvatī bhiṣagindrāya duha indriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspati the Immolator, the Lord of Hundred Powers, and awful Passion, \the King, the Tiger, and the Asvins, with reverence. Sarasvatt! the Physician yields wrath and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षदग्निं स्वाहाऽऽज्यस्य स्तोकानां स्वाहा मेदसां पृथक् स्वाहा छागमश्विभ्यां स्वाहा मेषं सरस्वत्यै स्वाह ऋषभमिन्द्राय सिंहाय सहस इन्द्रियं स्वाहाऽग्निं न भेषजं स्वाहा सोममिन्द्रियं स्वाहेन्द्रं सुत्रामाण सवितारं वरुणं भिषजां पतिं स्वाहा वनस्पतिं प्रियं पाथो न भेषजं स्वाहा देवा आज्यपा जुषाणो अग्निर्भेषजं पयः सोमः परिस्रुता घृतं मधु व्यन्त्वाज्यस्य होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadagniṃ svāhā''jyasya stokānāṃ svāhā medasāṃ pṛthak svāhā chāgamaśvibhyāṃ svāhā meṣaṃ sarasvatyai svāha ṛṣabhamindrāya siṃhāya sahasa indriyaṃ svāhā'gniṃ na bheṣajaṃ svāhā somamindriyaṃ svāhendraṃ sutrāmāṇa savitāraṃ varuṇaṃ bhiṣajāṃ patiṃ svāhā vanaspatiṃ priyaṃ pātho na bheṣajaṃ svāhā devā ājyapā juṣāṇo agnirbheṣajaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship Agni. Of the drops of clarified butter, Svdh! Of the fat, omentum, etc, severally, Svaha! the goat for the Asvins. Svah&! I the ram for Sarasvatt. SvAha! the bull for Indra. To the Lion, to his might, power. SvAhA! Agni the salutary remedy. ST&b! Soma, the power. SvAhA! Indra the Good Deliverer, Savitar, Varuna Lord of Physicians. SvAhA! Vanaspati, beloved, food and medicine. Sv&hk! I Gods who drink clarified butter. Agni accepting the medicine. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षदश्विनौ छागस्य वपाया मेदसो जुषेतां हविर्होतर्यज। होता यक्षत्सरस्वतीं मेषस्य वपाया मेदसो जुषतां हविर्होतर्यज। होता यक्षदिन्द्रमृषभस्य वपाया मेदसो जुषतां हविर्होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadaśvinau chāgasya vapāyā medaso juṣetāṃ havirhotaryaja hotā yakṣatsarasvatīṃ meṣasya vapāyā medaso juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja hotā yakṣadindramṛṣabhasya vapāyā medaso juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins with the omentum of a he -goat. Let them enjoy the fat. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Sarasvati with the omentum of a ram. Let her enjoy the fat. Hotar offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Indra with the omentum of a bull. Let him, etc.

verses.sa: होता यक्षदश्विनौ सरस्वतीमिन्द्रं सुत्रामाणमिमे सोमाः सुरामाणश्छागैर्न मेषैरृषभैः सुताः शष्पैर्न तोक्मभिर्लाजैर्महस्वन्तो मदा मासरेण परिष्कृताः शुक्राः पयस्वन्तोऽमृताः प्रस्थिता वो मधुश्चुतस्तानश्विना सरस्वतीन्द्रः सुत्रामा वृत्रहा जुषन्तां सोम्यं मधु पिबन्तु व्यन्तु होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadaśvinau sarasvatīmindraṃ sutrāmāṇamime somāḥ surāmāṇaśchāgairna meṣairṛṣabhaiḥ sutāḥ śaṣpairna tokmabhirlājairmahasvanto madā māsareṇa pariṣkṛtāḥ śukrāḥ payasvanto'mṛtāḥ prasthitā vo madhuścutastānaśvinā sarasvatīndraḥ sutrāmā vṛtrahā juṣantāṃ somyaṃ madhu pibantu vyantu hotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins, Sarasvatt, Indra the Good Deliverer, These your Soma, pressed, rejoieing ing with goats, rams, bulls, giving pleasure with rich shoots, young blades of corn, parched grain, joy-givers adorned with M^sara, bright, milky, immortal, presented, dropping honey, these let the Asvins, Sarasvati, Indra the Good Deliverer, Vritra-slayer, accept. Let them drink, rejoice in, enjoy the Soma meath. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sa: होता यक्षदश्विनौ छागस्य हविष आत्तामद्य मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतं पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभो घस्तां नूनं घासे अज्राणां यवसप्रथमानां सुमत्क्षराणां शतरुद्रियाणामग्निष्वात्तानां पीवोपवसानां पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः शितामत उत्सादतोऽङ्गादङ्गादवत्तानां करत एवाश्विना जुषेतां हविर्होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadaśvinau chāgasya haviṣa āttāmadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghastāṃ nūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānāṃ sumatkṣarāṇāṃ śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karata evāśvinā juṣetāṃ havirhotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins. Let them eat of the he-;; oat, the sacrifice. Let them to-day eat the fat, taken from the middle, before those who hate us, before human handling;. Yea, let them eat amid the fodder of fields f. fresh with moisture, with their expanse of barley, limbs of those tasted by Agni, belonging to the Hundred Rudras, portions covered with fat, from the sides, from the thighs, from the fore-feet from the chine. From every member of the divided victims these two make their repast. Thus let the Asvins accept. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation.

verses.sa: होता यक्षत् सरस्वतीं मेषस्य हविष आवयदद्य मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतं पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभो घसन्नूनं घासे अज्राणां यवसप्रथमानां सुमत्क्षराणां शतरुद्रियाणामग्निष्वात्तानां पीवोपवसनानां पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः शितामत उत्सादतोऽङ्गादङ्गादवत्तानां करदेवं सरस्वती जुषतां हविर्होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣat sarasvatīṃ meṣasya haviṣa āvayadadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghasannūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānāṃ sumatkṣarāṇāṃ śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasanānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karadevaṃ sarasvatī juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship Sarasvati. Let her approach the ram, the sacrifice. To-day let her eat, etc., the rest of verse repeated mutatis mutandis,

verses.sa: होता यक्षदिन्द्रमृषभस्य हविष आवयदद्य मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतं पुरा द्वेषोभ्यः पुरा पौरुषेय्या गृभो घसन्नूनं घासे अज्राणां यवसप्रथमानां सुमत्क्षराणां शतरुद्रियाणामग्निष्वात्तानां पीवोपवसानानां पार्श्वतः श्रोणितः शितामत उत्सादतोऽङ्गादङ्गादवत्तानां करदेवमिन्द्रो जुषतां हविर्होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadindramṛṣabhasya haviṣa āvayadadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghasannūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānāṃ sumatkṣarāṇāṃ śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasānānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karadevamindro juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship Indra, etc., as in mtUatis mtttandis,

verses.sa: होता यक्षद्वनस्पतिमभि हि पिष्टतमया रभिष्ठया रशनयाधित। यत्राश्विनोश्छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि यत्र सरस्वत्या मेषस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि यत्रेन्द्रस्य ऋषभस्य हविषः प्रिया धामानि यत्राग्नेः प्रिया धामानि यत्र सोमस्य प्रिया धामानि यत्रेन्द्रस्य सुत्राम्णः प्रिया धामानि यत्र सवितुः प्रिया धामानि यत्र वरुणस्य प्रिया धामानि यत्र वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथांसि यत्र देवानामाज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि यत्राग्नेर्होतुः प्रिया धामानि तत्रैतान्प्रस्तुत्येवोपस्तुत्येवोपावस्रक्षद्रभीयस इव कृत्वी करदेवं देवो वनस्पतिर्जुषतां हविर्होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadvanaspatimabhi hi piṣṭatamayā rabhiṣṭhayā raśanayādhita yatrāśvinośchāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra sarasvatyā meṣasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatrendrasya ṛṣabhasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatrāgneḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra somasya priyā dhāmāni yatrendrasya sutrāmṇaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra savituḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra varuṇasya priyā dhāmāni yatra vanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsi yatra devānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni yatrāgnerhotuḥ priyā dhāmāni tatraitānprastutyevopastutyevopāvasrakṣadrabhīyasa iva kṛtvī karadevaṃ devo vanaspatirjuṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspati. He has held with a very well formed and aud very strong rope. There where the favourite stations of the Asvins are, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Saras, vati, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there where the favourite stations of Agni are, of Soma, of Indra the Good Deliverer, of Savitar, of Varuna, the favourite places of Vanaspati, the favourite stations of Gods who drink clarified butter, and of Agni the Hotar, there let him arrange these victims when he has praised and lauded them, and perform when' he has made them very strong. Let divine Vanaspati accept. Hotar, offer oblation.

verses.sa: होता यक्षदग्निं स्विष्टकृतमयाडग्निरश्विनोश्छागस्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्ययाट् सरस्वत्या मेषस्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्ययाडिन्द्रस्य ऋषभस्य हविषः प्रिया धामान्ययाडग्नेः प्रिया धामान्ययाट् सोमस्य प्रिया धामान्ययाडिन्द्रस्य सुत्राम्णः प्रिया धामान्ययाट् सवितुः प्रिया धामान्ययाड् वरुणस्य प्रिया धामान्ययाड् वनस्पतेः प्रिया पाथांस्ययाड् देवानामाज्यपानां प्रिया धामानि यक्षदग्नेर्होतुः प्रिया धामानि यक्षत् स्वं महिमानमायजतामेज्या इषः कृणोतु सो अध्वरा जातवेदा जुषतां हविर्होतर्यज॥
verses.tr: hotā yakṣadagniṃ sviṣṭakṛtamayāḍagniraśvinośchāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmānyayāṭ sarasvatyā meṣasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmānyayāḍindrasya ṛṣabhasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmānyayāḍagneḥ priyā dhāmānyayāṭ somasya priyā dhāmānyayāḍindrasya sutrāmṇaḥ priyā dhāmānyayāṭ savituḥ priyā dhāmānyayāḍ varuṇasya priyā dhāmānyayāḍ vanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsyayāḍ devānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni yakṣadagnerhotuḥ priyā dhāmāni yakṣat svaṃ mahimānamāyajatāmejyā iṣaḥ kṛṇotu so adhvarā jātavedā juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja
verses.en: Let the Hotar worship Agni Svishtakrit. Let Agni worship the favourite stations of the Asvins, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvati, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there, etc., to 'butter' as in Let him worship the favourite stations of Agni the Hotar. Let him worship his own majesty. Let him win for himself by sacrifice food worthy of sacrifice. Let him, Knower of Beings, perform the sacred rites. Let him accept the sacrificial food. Hotar, offer oblation.

verses.sa: देवं बर्हिः सरस्वती सुदेवमिन्द्रे अश्विना। तेजो न चक्षुरक्ष्योर्बर्हिषा दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devaṃ barhiḥ sarasvatī sudevamindre aśvinā tejo na cakṣurakṣyorbarhiṣā dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: The (^Grass divine, for the right (Gods, Sarasvati, the Twain, Give Indra splendour, with the Grass, sight of his eyes and mighty strength! For gain liu of.wealth let them enjoy. Thou, Hotar, offer sacrifice.

verses.sa: देवीर्द्वारो अश्विना भिषजेन्द्रे सरस्वती। प्राणं न वीर्यं नसि द्वारो दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devīrdvāro aśvinā bhiṣajendre sarasvatī prāṇaṃ na vīryaṃ nasi dvāro dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: The Doors, the Doors divine, the Two Asvins, Leeches, Sarasvati—May they give breath to Indra in his nostrils, and heroic' strength, For gain of wealth, etc., as in verse

verses.sa: देवी उषासावश्विना सुत्रामेन्द्रे सरस्वती। बलं न वाचमास्य उषाभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devī uṣāsāvaśvinā sutrāmendre sarasvatī balaṃ na vācamāsya uṣābhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: May Dawn and Night, the Goddesses, both Asviiis, and Sarasvati Lay, with both Dawns, strength, voice within Indra the Good Deliverer's mouth. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sa: देवी जोष्ट्री सरस्वत्यश्विनेन्द्रमवर्धयन्। श्रोत्रं न कर्णयोर्यशो जोष्ट्रीभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devī joṣṭrī sarasvatyaśvinendramavardhayan śrotraṃ na karṇayoryaśo joṣṭrībhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: B)Both nursing G)Goddesses, the Pair of Asvins, and Sarasvati Have with both nurses given strength to Indra, fame, and power to hear. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sa: देवी ऊर्जाहुती दुघे सुदुघेन्द्रे सरस्वत्यश्विना भिषजाऽवतः। शुक्रं न ज्योति स्तनयोराहुती धत्त इन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devī ūrjāhutī dughe sudughendre sarasvatyaśvinā bhiṣajā'vataḥ śukraṃ na jyoti stanayorāhutī dhatta indriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, both Goddesses, well-yielding cows, Sarasvati, both Asvins, the Physicians, these are Indra's guards. Forth from their breasts "by sacrifice they give him brilliant light and power. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sa: देवा देवानां भिषजा होताराविन्द्रमश्विना। वषट्कारैः सरस्वती त्विषिं न हृदये मतिं होतृभ्यां दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devā devānāṃ bhiṣajā hotārāvindramaśvinā vaṣaṭkāraiḥ sarasvatī tviṣiṃ na hṛdaye matiṃ hotṛbhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: Both Gods, the Hotars of the Gods, the Asvins the Physicians and Sarasvati with V Vashat-calls, with the two Hotars have bestowed on Indra brilliant light and power, and planted wisdom in his heart. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sa: देवीस्तिस्रस्तिस्रो देवीरश्विनेडा सरस्वती। शूषं न मध्ये नाभ्यामिन्द्राय दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devīstisrastisro devīraśvineḍā sarasvatī śūṣaṃ na madhye nābhyāmindrāya dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: Goddesses three, three Goddesses—Asvins, Id\, Sarasvati In Indra's midmost navel have laid store of energy and power. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sa: देव इन्द्रो नराशंसस्त्रिवरूथः सरस्वत्यश्विभ्यामीयते रथः। रेतो न रूपममृतं जनित्रमिन्द्राय त्वष्टा दधदिन्द्रियाणि वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: deva indro narāśaṃsastrivarūthaḥ sarasvatyaśvibhyāmīyate rathaḥ reto na rūpamamṛtaṃ janitramindrāya tvaṣṭā dadhadindriyāṇi vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: God Narasamsa, Indra thrice-protecting, whose car moves by Sarasvati and May Asvins—M ly Tvashtar lay seed, deathless form in Indra, a fitting place of birth and mighty powers. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sa: देवो देवैर्वनस्पतिर्हिरण्यपर्णो अश्विभ्यां सरस्वत्या सुपिप्पल इन्द्राय पच्यते मधु। ओजो न जूतिरृषभो न भामं वनस्पतिर्नो दधदिन्द्रियाणि वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devo devairvanaspatirhiraṇyaparṇo aśvibhyāṃ sarasvatyā supippala indrāya pacyate madhu ojo na jūtirṛṣabho na bhāmaṃ vanaspatirno dadhadindriyāṇi vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: God with the Gods, Vanaspati of golden leaves and goodly fruit Ripens till Indra finds it sweet, with Asvins and Sarasvati.

verses.sa: देवं बर्हिर्वारितीनामध्वरे स्तीर्णमश्विभ्यामूर्णम्रदाः सरस्वत्या स्योनमिन्द्र ते सदः। ईशायै मन्युं राजानं बर्हिषा दधुरिन्द्रियं वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devaṃ barhirvāritīnāmadhvare stīrṇamaśvibhyāmūrṇamradāḥ sarasvatyā syonamindra te sadaḥ īśāyai manyuṃ rājānaṃ barhiṣā dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: Strewn, soft as wool, in sacrifice, with Asvins and Sarasvati, The sacred robe of water-plants be, Indra, a fair seat for thee! I Together with the sacred grass may they, for sovranty, bestow King Passion and great power on thee. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sa: देवो अग्निः स्विष्टकृद्देवान्यक्षद्यथायथं होताराविन्द्रमश्विना वाचा वाचं सरस्वतीमग्निं सोमं स्विष्टकृत् स्विष्ट इन्द्रः सुत्रामा सविता वरुणो भिषगिष्टो देवो वनस्पतिः स्विष्टा देवा आज्यपाः स्विष्टो अग्निरग्निना होता होत्रे स्विष्टकृद्यशो न दधदिन्द्रियमूर्जमपचितिं स्वधां वसुवने वसुधेयस्य व्यन्तु यज॥
verses.tr: devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛddevānyakṣadyathāyathaṃ hotārāvindramaśvinā vācā vācaṃ sarasvatīmagniṃ somaṃ sviṣṭakṛt sviṣṭa indraḥ sutrāmā savitā varuṇo bhiṣagiṣṭo devo vanaspatiḥ sviṣṭā devā ājyapāḥ sviṣṭo agniragninā hotā hotre sviṣṭakṛdyaśo na dadhadindriyamūrjamapacitiṃ svadhāṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja
verses.en: Let the God Agni Svishtakrit worship the Gods as is meet and right for each, the two Hotars, Indra, the Asvins, V&ic with speech, Sarasvati, Agni, Soma. Svishtakrit has been well worshipped, Indra Good Deliverer, Savitar, Vai'una the Physician have been worshipped. The God Vanaspati, the Gods who drink clarified butter have been well worshipped, Agni by Agni. Let the Hotar Svishtakrit give the Hotar fame, great power, energy, honour, Ancestral libation.

verses.sa: अग्निमद्य होतारमवृणीतायं यजमानः पचन् पक्तीः पचन् पुरोडाशान् बध्नन्नश्विभ्यां छागं सरस्वत्यै मेषमिन्द्राय ऋषभं सुन्वन्नश्विभ्यां सरस्वत्या इन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे सुरासोमान्॥
verses.tr: agnimadya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamānaḥ pacan paktīḥ pacan puroḍāśān badhnannaśvibhyāṃ chāgaṃ sarasvatyai meṣamindrāya ṛṣabhaṃ sunvannaśvibhyāṃ sarasvatyā indrāya sutrāmṇe surāsomān
verses.en: To-day this Sacrificer cooking viands, cooking sacrificial rice-cakes, binding a goat for the Asvins, a ram for Sarasvati, i, a bull for Indra, pressing Sur& and Soma juices for the Asvins, Sarasvati, and Indra the Good Deliverer, has chosen Agni as Hotar.

verses.sa: सूपस्था अद्य देवो वनस्पतिरभवदश्विभ्यां छागेन सरस्वत्यै मेषेणेन्द्राय ऋषभेणाक्षँस्तान् मेदस्तः प्रति पचतागृभीषतावीवृधन्त पुरोडाशैरपुरश्विना सरस्वतीन्द्रः सुत्रामा सुरासोमान्॥
verses.tr: sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavadaśvibhyāṃ chāgena sarasvatyai meṣeṇendrāya ṛṣabheṇākṣaṃstān medastaḥ prati pacatāgṛbhīṣatāvīvṛdhanta puroḍāśairapuraśvinā sarasvatīndraḥ sutrāmā surāsomān
verses.en: To-day the divine Vanaspati has done good service to the Asvins with a goat, to Sarasvati with a ram, to Indra with a bull. They have eaten these from the marrow onwards, they have accepted the cooked viands, they have waxed strong with the rice-cakes. The Agnis, Sarasvati, and Indra have drunk the Sur& and Soma draughts.

verses.sa: त्वामद्य ऋष आर्षेय ऋषीणां नपादवृणीतायं यजमानो बहुभ्य आ सङ्गतेभ्य एष मे देवेषु वसु वार्यायक्ष्यत इति ता या देवा देव दानान्यदुस्तान्यस्मा आ च शास्वा च गुरस्वेषितश्च होतरसि भद्रवाच्याय प्रेषितो मानुषः सूक्तवाकाय सूक्ता ब्रूहि॥
verses.tr: tvāmadya ṛṣa ārṣeya ṛṣīṇāṃ napādavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamāno bahubhya ā saṅgatebhya eṣa me deveṣu vasu vāryāyakṣyata iti tā yā devā deva dānānyadustānyasmā ā ca śāsvā ca gurasveṣitaśca hotarasi bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhi
verses.en: Thee, to-day, O ishi, B^ishi's, son, descendant of Rishis, hath this Sacrificer chosen for many collected, saying: This (Agni) shall win by sacrifice for me choice-worthy trap treasures among the Gods. O God, what gifts the Gods have given, these do thou desire and approve. And thou art a commissioned Hotar, a human H Hotar sent forward for benediction, for good speech. Speak thou good words.
